scope: Six paths with retained results: CPU Full/LatestOnly, GPU Full/LatestOnly, native serial/parallel. Managed allocation counts include all process threads. GPU BuildAsync includes host staging, transfer, kernel dispatch and readback; setup, cached kernel/workspace creation and post-measurement disposal are excluded. Native replay includes P-1 seed bars, state creation and result writes. Setup verifies independent owned/native references, exact native serial/parallel parity and exact device versus CPU results with explicit GPU backend assertion.
limitations: Warmed-workspace managed allocations, not total GPU/resident/native memory. No elapsed-time measurement or speedup claim. CPU observed at 71 percent during fixture inspection; other repository test jobs remain active. GPU timing qualification pending.
